analysis_findings.finding: O93 ingest_knowledge preserves source metadata/chunks and can select the legacy lexical plugin; no itoken/vtoken multi-space weighted final index in inherited pipeline.
ProbeFactory already has unique/versioned candidates, mirror/composition and adaptive-search checkpoints, but bounded candidate status is explicitly not generalization proof.
AutonomousLoop has exclusive workspace locking, pulses, stop/checkpoint and toggled reasoning memory; current UI starts it, runtime construction alone does not.
The inherited desktop has Chat/Task, Observer, Sources/RAG, Probes/Competencies, Autonomy/Memory tabs; many requested administrative workspaces are not yet exposed in distinct testable UI flows.
Observation, ingest and acquisition support overlapping but non-identical format sets. Successful observation of bytes/metadata does not imply document decoding or semantic ingestion.

scope_warning: Le fichier source_corpus_audit.json traite chacun des 1 616 fichiers; les textes sont décodés/analysés structurellement et les PDF textuellement extraits. Les binaires restent hashés/métadonnées, Parquet non décodé, et cela ne prétend pas être une compréhension sémantique humaine de tous médias.
